title: Summoned creature
wikitext:
{{TOCright}}

A [[summoned creature]] is a [[creature trait]] of an [[Non-player character|NPC]] that is typically brought into being by a [[character]] or NPC, including:
* [[Minion]]s animated by [[Necromancer]]s.
* [[Spirit]]s invoked by [[Ritualist]] [[binding ritual]]s or [[Ranger]] [[nature ritual]]s.
* The four [[Asura summon]]s.
* The creatures summoned by two of the [[Celestial skill]]s, [[Star Strike]] and [[Celestial Summoning]].

== Notes ==

* [[Skill]]s that summon creatures can be identified by various [[nomenclature|keywords]] in their descriptions: animated, bound, controlled, created, linked, owned, and [[ritual]].
* The summoner can see the amount of [[damage]] the summoned creature is dealing to [[foe]]s.
* Minions and spirits may be viewed in the [[User interface#Minion List|Minion List]] (default key: Y). 
* These [[creature]]s are flagged (by the game's mechanics) with a separate ''trait'', called ''summoned creature''.

; Creatures with conflicting traits
* Some creatures are flagged by the [[game mechanics]] as summoned, although they are present as part of the environment and were not brought into being by a character or NPC, e.g. the spirits in [[Slavers' Exile]].
* The [[Ebon Vanguard Assassin|Assassin]] summoned by [[Ebon Vanguard Assassin Support]] is not considered by the game as a ''summoned creature''. However, it will still trigger [[Spirit's Gift]], [[Explosive Growth]], and [[Boon of Creation]].
* [[Swap]] will not trigger and [[#Skills that do extra damage against summoned creatures|certain skills will not do extra damage]] when targeting [[Asura summon]]s, perhaps because they are considered to be animated [[Polymock]] pieces that are created with Asuran technology.
* [[Signet of Creation]] will not generate energy in the presence of the Asuran Summons, the Ebon Vanguards, or any [[summoning stone]] creatures. These NPCs are considered ''linked'' rather than ''controlled'' by the summoner.
